title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Mandatory Withdrawal
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Which of the following scenarios strictly triggers a **mandatory withdrawal** from representing a client?
options: The client becomes extremely uncooperative and verbally abusive toward the paralegal.
The client refuses to accept the paralegal's advice on whether to accept a settlement offer.
The client instructs the paralegal to use a falsified medical report as evidence in a hearing.
The paralegal realizes they significantly underquoted the client for the required legal work.
questions.explain: Rule 8.02 states mandatory withdrawal is triggered if the client instructs the paralegal to act contrary to the Rules (such as introducing fabricated evidence/fraud). Abusive behavior or refusal of advice typically falls under permissive withdrawal (breakdown of the relationship).
